question: On which of the following dates is the Good Governance Day observed in India every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 December.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On the **25th of December**__, India commemorates **Good Governance Day**.
